title: Efficient Token-Level Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion Models via Velocity Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2603.01563v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) successfully aligns autoregressive models in rigorous domains like mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, applying RLVR to Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) is hindered by intractable sequence-level likelihoods, forcing existing methods to rely on unstable, high-variance approximations. We propose Sequence Likelihood-Free Policy Optimization (LFPO), an efficient framework that circumvents this bottleneck by formulating policy alignment as discrete velocity alignment. Inspired by continuous flow matching, LFPO eschews trajectory-level estimation and directly optimizes denoising logits via contrastive token-level updates, providing a stable, low-variance surrogate. Furthermore, predicting terminal solutions from intermediate states implicitly straightens the generation trajectory, enabling high-quality sampling with significantly fewer denoising iterations.

translated_title: 基于速度对齐的掩码扩散模型高效词元级策略优化
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已在数学推理和代码生成等严格要求领域成功对齐了自回归模型。然而，将RLVR应用于扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）时受到难以处理的序列级似然的阻碍，迫使现有方法依赖不稳定且高方差的近似方法。我们提出了序列无似然策略优化，这是一种高效框架，通过将策略对齐表述为离散速度对齐来规避这一瓶颈。受连续流匹配的启发，LFPO摒弃了轨迹级估计，通过对比式的词元级更新直接优化去噪logits，提供了稳定且低方差的替代方案。此外，从中间状态预测最终解的方式隐式地拉直了生成轨迹，使得能够以显著更少的去噪迭代实现高质量采样。
tldr: 提出LFPO框架，将扩散大语言模型的策略对齐转化为离散速度对齐问题，通过词元级对比更新直接优化去噪logits，实现稳定低方差的强化学习对齐，并显著减少去噪迭代次数。
en_tdlr: LFPO circumvents intractable sequence-level likelihoods in diffusion LLMs by formulating policy alignment as discrete velocity alignment, directly optimizing denoising logits via contrastive token-level updates to achieve stable, low-variance RLVR and high-quality sampling with far fewer denoising iterations.
